description.value: Sweet Cherubim is a long-established organic and natural foods store paired with a fully vegan restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, one of the city's most cycling-friendly corridors. Cyclists can dine in or grab takeout from a wide plant-based menu spanning samosas, burgers, wraps, salads, soups, and desserts. The attached store carries bulk pantry staples, health supplements, baked goods, and personal care items, making it a practical resupply stop as well as a meal destination.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 49m; rack at 61m; stands (4 spaces) at 64m; rack at 67m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sweet Cherubim is an 'Organic & Natural Foods Store and Vegan Restaurant' at 1109 Commercial Drive, corroborating the OSM address and establishing it is far more than a standard cafe. The website's menu navigation explicitly lists both a 'Takeout' section and a 'Dine-In Menu,' and the business description and entire menu are plant-based/vegan. No evidence appears anywhere in the fetched content for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities; the Contact & Hours subpage was largely navigation and yielded no phone or address confirmation.
